Recorded against current dependencies

Source: R/glow_run_records.R
glow_dependency_differences.Rd

Recorded against current dependencies

glow_dependency_differences(recorded, current, seeded = FALSE)

Arguments

recorded

The dependencies of a completion record.

current

The dependencies of the current run, in the same form: a list of the named character vectors settings, inputs, files and versions.

seeded

Logical. TRUE for the record of files that were supplied and not produced by a run (see glow_seed_unit()). Such a record states the settings the files were built with and nothing else, so only the settings are compared.

Value

A character vector with one line per difference, naming the group and the key with the recorded and the current value. Empty when the two are the same.

Details

Two dependencies are the same when they have the same keys and every value is the same text (see glow_setting_text()). A key on one side only is a difference. Long values are shortened in the message, not in the comparison.

Examples

a <- list(settings = c(x = "1L"), inputs = character(0), files = character(0),
          versions = c(GLOWr = "0.3.6"))
b <- a; b$settings[["x"]] <- "2L"
glow_dependency_differences(a, b)
#> [1] "setting x: recorded 1L, now 2L"
